title: When More Thinking Hurts: Overthinking in LLM Test-Time Compute Scaling
authors_zh: Shu Zhou、Rui Ling、Junan Chen、Hao Wang（南京大学）；Xin Wang（百度）；Tao Fan（南京财经大学）
paper_type_zh: 测试时计算扩展评测与效率分析
best_for_zh: 需要选择停止预算，或评估自适应推理系统且希望得到准确率—成本曲线而非单一最大预算分数的读者。
one_line: This study shows that longer reasoning can reverse correct answers and proposes marginal-utility and flip-event analysis for selecting test-time budgets.
这项研究显示，更长的推理会把原本正确的答案改错，并用边际效用和答案翻转分析来选择测试时预算。
why: It supplies a concrete failure mode for indiscriminate test-time scaling and turns “when to stop” into a measurable allocation decision.
inclusion_reason: It measures the marginal value of additional reasoning tokens and shows why a compute-allocation policy needs stopping criteria rather than assuming monotonic gains from longer chains.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Test-time scaling is often evaluated as though more reasoning tokens should monotonically improve an answer. That assumption encourages fixed, long budgets even for questions that have already been solved, and it hides the deployment cost of generating thousands of extra tokens. A longer trace can also invite a model to second-guess a valid conclusion, so the maximum budget may be neither the most accurate nor the most efficient choice.

The paper asks how the marginal return of extra reasoning changes with budget and problem difficulty. It needs an analysis that can distinguish useful reconsideration from harmful revision at the level of individual questions, rather than only reporting a final accuracy average. The resulting decision problem is when a serving system should stop allocating thought tokens once the expected gain no longer justifies their cost.

测试时扩展常被评估得仿佛更多推理词元必然会单调地改善答案。这个假设会鼓励即使问题已经解出也使用固定的长预算，并掩盖生成数千额外词元的部署成本。更长的轨迹还可能引诱模型反复怀疑一个有效结论，因此最大预算既可能不是最准确的选择，也可能不是最高效的选择。

论文研究额外推理的边际回报如何随预算和问题难度变化。它需要一种能在单个问题层面区分有用复核与有害改写的分析，而不是只报告最终准确率平均值。由此产生的决策问题是：一旦预期收益不再值得其成本，服务系统应在何时停止分配思考词元。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central claim is that test-time compute has diminishing, and sometimes negative, marginal utility. The authors make this visible by following the same question across many forced reasoning budgets. An answer changing from wrong to correct is a positive flip; changing from correct to wrong is a negative flip. When negative flips dominate, giving the model more room to think is no longer a neutral expense but a source of error.

They therefore treat stopping as a cost-sensitive allocation problem. Accuracy should be read together with a compute penalty and an efficiency frontier, not as an isolated score at the largest token limit. Difficulty matters because easy problems reach the harmful regime sooner than hard ones, so a uniform budget wastes computation and can actively damage outputs that a shorter trajectory had already solved.

核心主张是，测试时计算的边际效用会递减，有时甚至为负。作者通过在许多强制推理预算下跟踪同一道题，使这一点可见。答案从错变对称为正向翻转；从对变错称为负向翻转。当负向翻转占主导时，给模型更多思考空间不再只是中性的开销，而会成为错误来源。

因此，论文把停止视为成本敏感的分配问题。准确率应与计算惩罚和效率前沿一同阅读，而不能只看最大词元限制下的孤立分数。难度很重要，因为简单问题比困难问题更早进入有害区间，所以统一预算既浪费算力，也可能主动损害原本已被较短轨迹解出的结果。

title: Method
方法
html:
DeepSeek-R1-32B and s1-32B are evaluated deterministically from 500 to 16,000 reasoning tokens in 500-token increments. When a model tries to finish early, budget forcing appends a “Wait” cue; at the assigned limit, decoding is forced to the end-of-thinking delimiter. For every prompt and budget, the study records the complete trace, final answer, correctness, and token-level log probabilities on AIME 2024/2025, difficulty-labeled MATH-500, and GPQA Diamond.

The analysis computes marginal utility as the accuracy change per 500 added tokens, then tracks each answer transition between adjacent budgets. It reports positive and negative flips, their ratio, and textual indicators such as hesitation markers, answer oscillation, and confidence trajectories. A cost-aware utility subtracts a normalized compute term weighted by a deployment sensitivity parameter, making the preferred stopping point move as compute becomes more expensive.

作者让 DeepSeek-R1-32B 与 s1-32B 在 500 到 16,000 个推理词元之间，以 500 为间隔进行确定性评估。当模型试图过早结束时，预算强制会追加“Wait”提示；达到指定限制时，解码被强制到思考结束分隔符。对 AIME 2024/2025、带难度标记的 MATH-500 和 GPQA Diamond 中的每个提示与预算，研究记录完整轨迹、最终答案、正确性和词元级对数概率。

分析将每增加 500 个词元所带来的准确率变化计算为边际效用，并追踪相邻预算之间的每次答案转换。它报告正向与负向翻转、两者比率，以及犹豫标记、答案震荡和置信度轨迹等文本指标。一个成本敏感效用函数减去由部署敏感参数加权的归一化计算项，使首选停止点会随计算变得更昂贵而移动。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On AIME, DeepSeek-R1-32B’s reported marginal utility falls from +3.2 percentage points per 500 tokens between 0.5K and 2K to −0.3 beyond 12K; accuracy peaks at 55.8% at 12K and falls to 54.9% at 16K. The corresponding s1 model turns negative earlier. Across R1 trajectories, the cumulative negative-to-positive flip ratio passes one around 7K tokens and rises to 7.55 at 16K, indicating that harmful revisions increasingly outnumber repairs.

The pattern is not confined to a single forced setup. Easy MATH-500 items cross the overthinking threshold at roughly 2K tokens while the hardest group benefits to roughly 8K, and GPQA Diamond peaks near 10K before declining. The authors report 76.3% precision at 80% recall for combined overthinking indicators, 67.5% genuine reconsideration among 80 examined negative flips, and similar decline patterns in 312 naturally generated traces longer than 8K tokens.

在 AIME 上，DeepSeek-R1-32B 报告的边际效用从 0.5K 到 2K 区间每 500 个词元增加 3.2 个百分点，降至 12K 以后每 500 个词元减少 0.3 个百分点；准确率在 12K 时达到 55.8% 的峰值，并在 16K 时降至 54.9%。对应的 s1 模型更早转为负值。对 R1 轨迹而言，累计负向与正向翻转的比率在约 7K 词元时超过一，并在 16K 时升至 7.55，表明有害改写越来越多于修正。

这种模式并不限于单一的强制设置。简单的 MATH-500 题目在约 2K 词元越过过度思考阈值，而最难组可从思考中受益到约 8K；GPQA Diamond 则在约 10K 达到峰值后下降。作者报告组合过度思考指标在 80% 召回率下达到 76.3% 精确率，随机检查的 80 次负向翻转中有 67.5% 属于真正的反复考虑，且在 312 条自然生成且长于 8K 词元的轨迹中观察到相似下降模式。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is not another way to make a model reason longer. It supplies a diagnostic vocabulary for the failure of that strategy: marginal utility, positive and negative answer flips, and a difficulty-specific overthinking threshold. These quantities make it possible to say that a longer chain was harmful to a particular previously solved example, rather than inferring efficiency only from a mean accuracy curve.

The paper also changes the comparison target for test-time methods. Instead of treating the highest observed accuracy as the whole objective, it asks for a cost-aware frontier and a selectable stopping point. This is a useful complement to search and verifier proposals because it evaluates whether their added tokens should be spent at all, and it highlights that more test-time computation can be a quality risk as well as a latency cost.

贡献并不是提出另一种让模型思考更久的方法，而是为这种策略的失效提供诊断语言：边际效用、正向和负向答案翻转，以及与难度相关的过度思考阈值。这些量使人能够指出更长的推理链如何伤害某个此前已解对的样例，而不是只从平均准确率曲线间接推断效率。

论文还改变了测试时方法的比较目标。它不再把观测到的最高准确率视为全部目标，而要求成本敏感的前沿和可选择的停止点。这对搜索与验证器方案是有用补充，因为它评估这些新增词元是否根本值得花费，并强调更多测试时计算既可能是延迟成本，也可能是质量风险。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The study covers two open 32B models and mathematical or scientific benchmarks, so its thresholds should not be read as universal deployment defaults. Budget forcing is carefully checked against a natural-long-trace subset but still differs from unconstrained interactive use. The indicators correlate with negative flips rather than proving their causal mechanism, and the paper proposes an evaluation framework rather than releasing a trained adaptive stopping policy or an official code package.
研究覆盖两个开放权重的 32B 模型以及数学或科学基准，因此其中阈值不应被理解为通用部署默认值。预算强制虽与自然长轨迹子集进行了仔细核对，仍不同于不受约束的交互式使用。各指标与负向翻转相关，却不能证明其因果机制；论文提出的是评测框架，而非发布一个训练完成的自适应停止策略或官方代码包。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this card when selecting a reasoning-token cap, comparing test-time search policies, or deciding whether a new scaling method should report more than pass rate. Its measurements can be added to an internal serving evaluation: plot per-budget marginal gain, count answer regressions, segment by difficulty, and choose a stopping rule under an explicit cost sensitivity. It is a measurement paper, not a plug-in early-exit method, so a production policy still requires validation on the intended model and workload.
当需要选择推理词元上限、比较测试时搜索策略，或判断新的扩展方法是否应报告通过率之外的指标时，可使用这张卡。其测量方法可以加入内部服务评估：绘制逐预算边际收益，统计答案退化，按难度分组，并在明确成本敏感度下选择停止规则。这是一篇测量论文，而不是可直接接入的早退方法，因此生产策略仍需在目标模型和工作负载上验证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the natural-long-reasoning validation and the flip definitions before generalizing the headline “more thinking hurts.” The most portable result is that accuracy-versus-budget curves hide individual-answer reversals and should be complemented with a cost frontier. A useful follow-up experiment is to run the same traces through an independently designed stopping policy, because the paper’s indicator analysis is diagnostic and not a causal intervention.
在把“思考更多会有害”这一醒目结论推广之前，应先阅读自然长推理验证和翻转定义。最具可迁移性的结果是：准确率—预算曲线会掩盖单个答案的反转，因而应补充成本前沿。一个有价值的后续实验是让同一批轨迹经过独立设计的停止策略，因为论文的指标分析属于诊断，而不是因果干预。
